column1: # Type-aware typescript-eslint rules: every rule documented as `requiresTypeChecking`.
# Source: typescript-eslint, main branch at commit 706298716de5edb95ff58a1ba8806f88f87423e7,
#   - The rule list is the generated `disable-type-checked` config
#     typescript-eslint generates from every rule whose `meta.docs.requiresTypeChecking`
#   - `syntax_only_equivalent` is the core ESLint rule a typescript-eslint EXTENSION
#     rule builds on (`meta.docs.extendsBaseRule` in that rule's source,
#     `-` means typescript-eslint documents no syntax-only base rule. The base rule
#     is NOT a drop-in replacement: it checks less, because it cannot see types.
#     Whether it covers the same check in a given repo is the question the OPT82
#     prompt asks, never an answer this file gives.
#   - `type_checked_presets` lists the typescript-eslint type-checked presets that
#     turn the rule on (from the generated recommended-, strict- and
#     `recommended` does. The `all` preset turns every rule in this file on.
# Format: one rule per line, TAB-separated, sorted and deduplicated (a test pins
# both). Lines starting with `#` are comments.
